candidates.description: This feature vector represents the Thai consonant character 'ค' (kho khwai) and its various combinations with vowel marks, tone markers, and surrounding sub-word tokens.
This feature vector represents Thai character sequences ending with the consonant ท (tho thahan).
This vector activates for Thai vowel and tone mark characters, which modify the pronunciation of consonants.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai nominalization prefixes and common noun suffixes involving actions, processes, and systems.
This feature vector activates strongly on non-English subword units, particularly from Thai and French typography.
The tokens represent references to opioid substances alongside fragments of Thai script, likely capturing pharmaceutical or drug-related content in multilingual contexts.
This vector represents pharmaceutical and medical terminology, specifically relating to opioid medications and manufacturers like Bayer.
This vector is related to subword fragments and mixed-script character sequences from various languages.
This vector activates on token fragments, suffixes, and unrelated foreign text across multiple languages.
These tokens are common English and international derivational suffixes and morphological endings used to form adjectives, nouns, and chemical terms.
